name: Hazleton Area School District
hero_alt: Paving crew at Hazleton Area School District
paragraphs: With students returning for the new school year, timing was everything on this parking lot paving project for Hazleton Area School District. Our paving crew resurfaced the lot from base through finish coat, working against a hard deadline to have the site ready before the first day back.

As our crew put it at the time: “Making it black just in time for back-to-school students starting on Monday.” The project came together on schedule, giving the district a freshly paved, safe lot for staff and buses alike.

summary: Parking lot paving completed ahead of the start of the school year.
